description.narrative: Ireland supports research and policy exchange between the EU and the Global South through core funding to the European Centre for Development Policy Management; and also provides core funding to the International Organisation for Migration (IOM), the UN organisation charged with the orderly and humane management of migration globally. Ireland is a member of the Multilateral Organisation Performance Assessment Network (MOPAN). MOPAN independently assesses organisational and development effectiveness and the results of Multilateral Organisations. Ireland is a founding member of the International Fund for Agricultral Development (IFAD); an international financial institution and a specialised UN agency dedicated to eradicating poverty and hunger in rural areas of developing countries. Through loans and grants, IFAD supports programmes and projects that support poor and vulnerable rural communities through the promotion of sustianable agricultural growth that is inclusive and environmentally sustainable. Irish Aid funds two additional Junior Professionals in Delegations (JPDs) posts for the 2021-23 program as well as the upcoming 2023-25 program. This funding contributes to furthering opportunities for Irish young professionals to have a career in the EU institutions, as well as giving Irish Aid a greater opportunity to place JPDs in countries or regions that align best with our priorities.

Irish engagement in EU policy on development and other policy areas strengthened. Ireland contributes effectively to the ability of IOM to carry our its mandate, including in relation to the implementation of the Global Compact for Migration. Our contribution to MOPAN funds the production of assessments of MOs in line with Network member priorities, and other products, including analytical studies on cross-cutting issues relevant to multilateral effectiveness, including Covid 19 response, and SEAH. The Irish Aid funding of two additional Junior Professionals in Delegations (JPDs) posts contributes to furthering opportunities for Irish young professionals to have a career in the EU institutions, as well as giving Irish Aid a greater opportunity to place JPDs in countries or regions that align best with our geographic and thematic priorities from ABW.
